comment: The AI-foundations list leans on longitudinal data but omits the time dimension of semantics. Terminologies and models change over the span longitudinal data covers; without version-aware, point-in-time semantics and cross-version mappings, models inherit drift along the time axis. We recommend adding versioning and temporal consistency as an explicit AI foundation. The draft already has the primitives — Terminology/LIMR versioning, point-in-time benefit definitions. This should also extend to deterministic services whose definitions change over time.
